Problem (rule): today the role file is pruned at 7 days, so an old session loses its role; changing that changes how long a role record lives, which is your call.
Based on (read): the consultant's reading of the Degen gap audit: an old session that resumes, compacts or clears with no role env loses its role (not re-read by triage).
Departs from: main — the role file is pruned at 7 days — it is kept on resume, compact or clear when the role env is missing, and refreshed at each session start.
Waiting on: nothing is stopped; the consultant builds it on a yes.
